tagline: I build custom SAP S/4HANA solutions and the data pipelines around them — from ABAP objects and RAP business objects to warehouses that feed the reports leadership actually reads.
summary: SAP ABAP Developer with 3 years of hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA, specializing in custom development, system integration, and performance optimization. I have delivered 60+ reports and enhancements across MM, SD, FI, FM, WM, PP and QM, and contributed to large-scale S/4HANA implementation projects for manufacturing, pharmaceutical, retail and public-transport clients.

Alongside ABAP, I work on the data side: designing warehouses, building ETL pipelines with SSIS and SAP CI-DS, and modelling data for BI. That combination lets me carry a requirement end to end — from the business process inside SAP all the way to the number on a dashboard.
